# 74H21 - Dual 4-input AND gate

Package DIP-14 · family 74H · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74H21.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74H21.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 8 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74H21 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74H21.png) | ![74H21 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/and4.png) | ![74H21 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/and4.png) |

The split AND rectangle (triangle in the right half) with four inputs.

How to tell it on a drawing: Four-input AND.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 1Y = 1A AND 1B AND 1C AND 1D | 1Y is the AND of 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D. |
| 8 | 2Y = 2A AND 2B AND 2C AND 2D | 2Y is the AND of 2A, 2B, 2C, 2D. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 8 | 15 |
| any | Y | PHL | 10 | 20 |

## Not known

- No 74H21 (high-speed TTL) datasheet was found. Pins and function come from the SN74LS21 sheet (same pinout); outputLowMaxCurrentMa, outputHighMaxCurrentMa and the real 74H propagation delays are unknown.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty. The timing entries are SN74LS figures (LS family) and must not be read as 74H values.

## Sources

- [TI SN54LS21/SN74LS21 datasheet SDLS139](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls21.pdf) - 1, 3; SN74LS21

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
